stories.title: England Approves Life-Extending Cancer Drug
stories.label: health
stories.summary: England's health service has given the green light to a new cancer treatment that helps patients live significantly longer. It means people facing one of the toughest diagnoses now have access to a drug that can genuinely extend their time with loved ones. The approval comes after the treatment showed clear, real-world benefits, not just promise in early trials. Thousands of patients across the country will now be eligible to receive it through the public health system. It's a concrete step forward in the fight against cancer, delivered where it counts most: in doctors' offices, not just in research papers.
stories.why_good: A real regulatory approval that will give actual patients access to a treatment proven to extend life, not a study or a promise.

stories.title: Unsealed for the First Time, This 600-yo Tomb in Peru Was Just Declared the 'Discovery of the Decade'
stories.label: science
stories.summary: Archaeologists in Peru just opened a 600-year-old tomb that had never been touched, and what they found inside is being called the discovery of the decade. It sits inside Chan Chan, a UNESCO World Heritage site that was once the capital of a major Andean civilization. Inside were the remains of 38 people along with a treasure trove of grave goods, offering an incredible window into a society from centuries ago. Finds like this help us understand more about the rich cultures that thrived in South America long before European contact. It's a wonderful reminder of how much history is still waiting to be uncovered.
stories.why_good: A genuine, completed archaeological discovery that expands human knowledge and celebrates an ancient culture, with no suffering, disaster, or politics involved.
